settings.calendar.mac_help: Uses titles and participants from your Mac calendar. To include Outlook, add your work account under System Settings → Internet Accounts.
settings.calendar.help: Uses meeting titles and participants from your calendar.
settings.recording.rule_help: For example, always record your recurring standup or never record “Lunch”. These rules override calendar and app rules.
settings.recording.shortcut: Use {shortcut} to start or stop recording
settings.speakers.legacy_help: The older speaker model still works, but cannot recognize voices across meetings. Download the new speaker models to enable this.

settings.speakers.unavailable: This version of Pennel cannot recognize speakers on this device. Choose “Through Pennel Cloud”.
settings.speakers.cloud_help: Your audio is sent to Pennel Cloud, processed in memory and not stored. Sign in to Pennel Cloud to use this.
settings.speakers.local_help: Recognizes voices on your computer. Your audio stays on this device.
settings.voice.forget_help: Pennel will no longer recognize you automatically on a shared microphone. Existing meetings stay as they are.
settings.voice.forget_known_help: Pennel will no longer name this voice in new meetings. Names in existing meetings stay in place.
settings.voice.forget_all_help: Your voice and all remembered voices will be removed from this device. Names in existing meetings stay in place.
settings.speakers.identity_help: Recognizes who spoke after the meeting. Remembered voices will be named automatically in future meetings.
settings.voice.title: Your voice
settings.voice.help: Your speech stays labeled “Me”, even when everyone shares one microphone. Only a voiceprint is kept on this device, never the recording.
settings.voice.known_help: Voices you chose to remember. Pennel names them automatically in future meetings.
settings.voice.known_empty: No remembered voices yet. Name a voice in a meeting and choose “Remember this voice”.
settings.voice.unavailable: Speaker recognition on this device is unavailable in this version of Pennel. Choose “Through Pennel Cloud”.
settings.voice.intro: Pennel will recognize you as “Me”, even when everyone shares one microphone. Only a voiceprint is kept on this device, never the recording.
settings.voice.recording_status: Pennel is listening. Read the text at a comfortable pace, then press Stop.
settings.voice.working_status: Pennel is processing your voice. This takes a few seconds.
settings.voice.idle_status: Read the text aloud at your normal pace. This takes about 25 seconds.

settings.live_text.title: Live text
settings.live_text.help: Show interim dictation text and meeting captions when the selected local or Apple speech provider supports them. Finalized text is saved as usual. Changes apply to new recordings.
settings.live_text.enabled: Show live text for dictation and meetings
settings.advanced.help: Manage connections and optional model features. Everyday speech and text setup stays beside Dictation and Meetings.
settings.setup.speech_download: {size} one-time download. Runs on this computer.
settings.writing.title: Writing profile
settings.writing.help: Learn your written voice from your own dictation and meeting speech. This preview helps ChatGPT and Claude write in your style.
settings.writing.disclosure: Pennel analyzes original transcripts with your selected text model, which may process them remotely. New ordinary dictations and eligible speech from existing and new finalized meetings can contribute. Other speakers, commands and AI-written text are excluded.
settings.writing.privacy: Only general style guidance is shared with assistants. Source passages and meeting facts stay out of the shared profile.
settings.writing.paused: Learning is paused. Your existing profile is retained; deleted sources still lose their influence.
settings.writing.delete_help: This removes learned evidence and your trait corrections, stops learning and turns off profile sharing. Your original dictations and meetings are kept.
settings.writing.empty: Keep speaking naturally. A profile becomes available for each language after enough repeated evidence.
settings.writing.threshold: Initially, each language needs at least {words} words across {sessions} separate capture sessions and repeated support for its traits.
settings.writing.limitations: Speech supports phrasing, directness and rhythm. It does not establish email sign-offs, punctuation or page layout preferences.
settings.writing.sources_help: Exclude a source to remove its influence. Deleting a dictation or meeting, including through retention, also removes its contribution.
settings.writing.sources_empty: New dictations and eligible finalized meetings will appear here.
settings.writing.sharing.title: Share with writing assistants
settings.writing.sharing.help: Share this computer’s ready profiles through a separate writing-profile connection. Connecting it grants no meeting access.
settings.writing.sharing.enabled: Allow assistants to read my writing profile
settings.writing.sharing.sign_in: Sign in to Pennel Cloud in Account to connect a writing assistant.
settings.writing.sharing.active: This computer is the profile source. Keep Pennel running when an assistant needs it.
settings.writing.sharing.other_source: Another computer is the profile source. Choose this computer explicitly to change it.
settings.writing.sharing.setup: In ChatGPT or Claude, add this connector URL and authorize writing-profile access. Enable Pennel in your chat and ask it to write in your style.
settings.writing.sharing.copy_error: Could not copy the connector URL.
settings.writing.error.generic: The writing profile could not be updated. Check your setup and try again.
settings.writing.error.provider: The selected text model is unavailable for profile analysis. Check its setup in Models.
settings.writing.error.preview: Writing profiles are available in Pennel Preview.
settings.writing.error.busy: Pennel is handling speech or another foreground task. Profile learning will continue when it is free.
settings.writing.source.eligibility: Meeting speech contributes only when your enrolled voice has a finalized, reliable attribution.
settings.writing.sharing.connection_erro: The writing-profile connection is unavailable. Check your Cloud connection and try again.
